source: Recorded from ustat_engine.stats.ttest and reproduced byte-for-byte by ustat_engine_r under R 4.5.2. The two sentences are not decoration: `interpretation` carries t and Hedges' g to 3 dp, and `result_text` carries both means to 2 dp, the Welch df to 2 dp and g's confidence interval to 3 dp -- so pinning these strings pins the effect size and its interval across both engines, which a fixture cannot otherwise reach (effect_sizes and summary are nested).

expected.interpretation: Significant difference between groups (t = -6.283, p = <0.001, Hedges' g = -0.724 [medium])
expected.methods_text: Group differences in sbp were compared between levels of arm using an independent-samples Welch's t-test. Effect size was quantified with Hedges' g and its 95% confidence interval. Normality of each group was assessed with the Shapiro-Wilk test (n < 50), the Lilliefors-corrected Kolmogorov-Smirnov test (50 ≤ n ≤ 2000), or a skewness/CLT criterion (n > 2000). Homogeneity of variances was checked with Levene's test.
expected.r_code: t.test(sbp ~ arm, data = data, var.equal = FALSE)
expected.result_text: The control group (M = 141.24) significantly differed from the treat group (M = 148.69), t(297.23) = -6.283, p = <0.001, hedges g = -0.724 (95% CI: -0.959–-0.489) [medium].
